articles.title: President Trump expected to meet with senators to work on ethics concerns in crypto bill
articles.snippet: The most contentious piece of the crypto market structure bill is unresolved in the final weeks of Senate runway, and the president is expected to discuss it.

articles.title: US Senator blasts AG pick for ‘dismantling’ crypto unit, Trump’s CZ pardon
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump’s pick for US Attorney General faced criticism from members of the Senate Judiciary Committee on his approach to crypto enforcement and the pardon of former Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao.

articles.title: US Government Moves $288M in Seized Crypto to Coinbase Prime
articles.snippet: The seized coins landed at the government's custodian, which stops short of a sale but has revived questions about Trump's no-sell pledge.

articles.title: Democratic Opposition to Clarity Act Grows in Crypto Bill's Do-or-Die Final Weeks
articles.snippet: Democrats are mounting a final case against the Clarity Act centered on its lack of language restricting Trump's sprawling crypto fortune.

articles.title: Democrats Call for Senate Hearings on Trump's Massive Crypto Profits
articles.snippet: Top Democrats on key Senate committees demanded inquiries into the more than $1.2 billion that President Trump made on crypto last year.
